name: Urban Soundscape Annoyance: Source Labels and Ratings (DeLTA)
description: Faithful replication: same task, scales and recordings as the paper (120 of the authors' open DeLTA binaural recordings, Zenodo 7158057, CC BY 4.0). Headphone listening test of urban soundscapes in London and Venice. After a sound check, a volume calibration with noise at the loudest and quietest recording levels and a six-trial Huggins-pitch headphone test (pass = 5 of 6), participants do 5 practice trials and then hear 10 random 15-second recordings. For each, they listen once and tick every sound source they hear from 24 labels (shown in a random layout per participant), then listen again and rate "How annoying is this sound?" from 1 (not at all) to 10 (extremely). The paper relates annoyance to the number of distinct sources (soundscape complexity) with mixed models. The page source holds the authors' majority labels and mean annoyance for every recording. Differences from the original study: (1) 120 recordings, 20 for each number of sources 1 to 6+, instead of all 2,890; (2) runs as one web page instead of Gorilla, with the test sounds generated in the browser; (3) gender and age are optional and other background questions are left out. Cite: Mitchell, Erfanian, Soelistyo, Oberman, Kang, Aldridge, Xue & Aletta (2022), Int. J. Environ. Res. Public Health 19(22): 14872.
author: Mitchell et al.

elements.title: Recorded by the page: Huggins-pitch headphone test, number correct out of 6 (Milne et al. 2021). Participants with fewer than 5 correct do not continue to the listening task.

elements.description: One record per recording: key = recording file (the DeLTA name, e.g. Rs118_2.mp3); value = the labels ticked. The page source (script id delta-original) has the authors' majority labels and mean annoyance for every recording.

elements.name: annoyance
elements.title: How annoying is this sound?
elements.description: One record per recording (key = recording file). 1 = not at all, 10 = extremely. Paper's analysis: mean annoyance per recording against the number of sound sources heard and against which sources were present.

For each recording they first tick every sound source they can hear (24 labels: traffic, birds, speech, construction, water…), then hear it again and rate “How annoying is this sound?” from 1 (not at all) to 10 (extremely). Rebuilt from Mitchell, Erfanian, Soelistyo, Oberman, Kang, Aldridge, Xue & Aletta (2022), Int. J. Environ. Res. Public Health 19(22): 14872, with the authors' open DeLTA recordings (Zenodo 7158057, CC BY 4.0). <style>
:root{--bg:#eff2f4;--card:#fff;--ink:#1a1f24;--muted:#56616b;--accent:#2d5d86;--accent-ink:#fff;--line:#d3dbe1;--warn:#b3261e;--ok:#2e7d32}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:16px/1.5 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif}
main{max-width:820px;margin:0 auto;padding:24px 16px 40px}
h1{font-size:1.45rem;margin:0 0 8px}p{margin:0 0 12px;color:var(--muted)}
.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:18px;margin-top:14px}
.btn{appearance:none;border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:12px 18px;font:inherit;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink)}
.btn.sec{background:var(--card);color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.btn:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed}
.row{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin-top:12px}
.progress{height:6px;background:var(--line);border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;margin:8px 0 14px}.progress>i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--accent)}
.play{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:18px;border-radius:12px;background:#e4ecf2}
.bar{flex:1;height:8px;background:#c9d6e0;border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden}.bar>i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:var(--accent)}
.labels{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:6px}
@media (max-width:620px){.labels{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
.labels button,.scale button,.iv button{appearance:none;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--card);color:var(--ink);border-radius:9px;padding:9px 4px;font:inherit;font-size:.92rem;cursor:pointer;min-width:0}
.labels button.on,.scale button.on{background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);border-color:var(--accent)}
.scale{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(10,1fr);gap:5px}.scale button{font-weight:700;padding:11px 0}
@media (max-width:480px){.scale{grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr)}}
.ends{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted);margin-top:3px}
.iv{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px;margin-top:12px}.iv button{padding:18px 0;font-weight:700}
.iv button.now{background:#dbe7f0}
label.opt{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:9px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;margin-top:6px;cursor:pointer}
.f{margin-top:14px}.f>b{display:block;margin-bottom:4px}
input[type=number]{font:inherit;padding:8px 10px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;width:120px}
.err{color:var(--warn);margin-top:8px;min-height:1.2em}
.credit{max-width:820px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 16px 24px;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted)}
</style>

<body>
<main id="app" aria-live="polite"><p>Loading…</p></main>
<footer class="credit">Recordings: DeLTA dataset (Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.7158057), 15-s excerpts of International Soundscape Database binaural recordings from London and Venice, CC BY 4.0. Headphone test after Milne et al. (2021).</footer>
<script>
(function(){
  var N=10, PRACTICE=5, PLAY_S=15;
  var app=document.getElementById('app'), Q={}, clips=[], prac=[], st=null, ctxA=null;
  function esc(s){return String(s==null?'':s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){return {'&':'&','<':'<','>':'>','"':'"'}[c];});}
  function err(m){var e=app.querySelector('.err');if(e)e.textContent=m||'';}
  function ok(r){return !(r&&r.ok===false);}
  function shuffle(a){a=a.slice();for(var k=a.length-1;k>0;k--){var j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(k+1));var x=a[k];a[k]=a[j];a[j]=x;}return a;}
  function save(){try{localStorage.setItem('delta2022:state',JSON.stringify(st));}catch(e){}}
  function ac(){if(!ctxA){var C=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;ctxA=new C();}if(ctxA.state==='suspended')ctxA.resume();return ctxA;}
  function byName(list,n){for(var i=0;i<list.length;i++)if(list[i].name===n)return list[i];return null;}

  // ---------- generated test sounds ----------
  function noiseBuffer(sec,dbfs,sr){var a=ac();sr=sr||a.sampleRate;var n=Math.round(sec*sr),b=a.createBuffer(2,n,sr),g=Math.pow(10,dbfs/20)*Math.sqrt(3);for(var c=0;c<2;c++){var d=b.getChannelData(c);for(var i=0;i<n;i++)d[i]=(Math.random()*2-1)*g;}return b;}
  function playBuffer(b,onend){var a=ac(),s=a.createBufferSource();s.buffer=b;s.connect(a.destination);s.onended=onend||null;s.start();return s;}
  function tune(){var a=ac(),sr=a.sampleRate,notes=[523.25,659.25,783.99,1046.5,783.99,659.25,523.25,659.25,783.99,659.25],len=0.5,n=Math.round(len*notes.length*sr),b=a.createBuffer(2,n,sr);
    for(var c=0;c<2;c++){var d=b.getChannelData(c);for(var i=0;i<n;i++){var k=Math.floor(i/(len*sr)),t=(i%(len*sr))/sr,env=Math.min(1,t*40)*Math.exp(-t*3);d[i]=0.18*env*Math.sin(2*Math.PI*notes[k]*t);}}return b;}
  // FFT for the Huggins-pitch stimulus
  function fft(re,im,inv){var n=re.length,i,j,k,l;for(i=1,j=0;i<n;i++){var bit=n>>1;for(;j&bit;bit>>=1)j^=bit;j^=bit;if(i<j){var t=re[i];re[i]=re[j];re[j]=t;t=im[i];im[i]=im[j];im[j]=t;}}
    for(l=2;l<=n;l<<=1){var ang=2*Math.PI/l*(inv?1:-1),wr=Math.cos(ang),wi=Math.sin(ang);for(i=0;i<n;i+=l){var cr=1,ci=0;for(k=0;k<l/2;k++){var a=i+k,b=i+k+l/2,tr=re[b]*cr-im[b]*ci,ti=re[b]*ci+im[b]*cr;re[b]=re[a]-tr;im[b]=im[a]-ti;re[a]+=tr;im[a]+=ti;var nr=cr*wr-ci*wi;ci=cr*wi+ci*wr;cr=nr;}}}
    if(inv)for(i=0;i<n;i++){re[i]/=n;im[i]/=n;}}
  function hpInterval(withPitch){
    // 1 s of the same white noise in both ears; for the target interval the band 600 Hz ± 6 % is phase-inverted in one ear (Huggins pitch)
    var a=ac(),sr=32768,n=32768,re=new Float64Array(n),im=new Float64Array(n),i;
    for(i=0;i<n;i++)re[i]=Math.random()*2-1;
    var L=Float32Array.from(re), R;
    if(withPitch){fft(re,im,false);var lo=Math.floor(600*0.94*n/sr),hi=Math.ceil(600*1.06*n/sr);for(i=lo;i<=hi;i++){re[i]=-re[i];im[i]=-im[i];re[n-i]=-re[n-i];im[n-i]=-im[n-i];}fft(re,im,true);R=Float32Array.from(re);}else R=Float32Array.from(L);
    var g=0.25/Math.sqrt(1/3), ramp=Math.round(0.02*sr), b=a.createBuffer(2,n,sr), dl=b.getChannelData(0), dr=b.getChannelData(1);
    for(i=0;i<n;i++){var e=Math.min(1,i/ramp,(n-1-i)/ramp)*g*0.2;dl[i]=L[i]*e;dr[i]=R[i]*e;}
    return b;
  }

  // ---------- screens ----------
  function intro(){
    if(clips.length<N){app.innerHTML='<h1>Recordings missing</h1><p>The media folder “clips” needs at least '+N+' recordings (now '+clips.length+').</p>';return;}
    app.innerHTML='<h1>Listening to urban places</h1><p>You will listen to short recordings of streets and squares and tell us which sounds you hear and how annoying the sound is. <b>Please wear headphones</b>, sit in a quiet room and use a computer. First we check your sound, set the volume and run a short headphone test. About 15 minutes.</p>'+
      '<div class="card"><div class="f" style="margin-top:0"><b>'+esc(Q.gender.title)+'</b>'+(Q.gender.choices||[]).map(function(c){return '<label class="opt"><input type="radio" name="gender" value="'+esc(c.value)+'"> '+esc(c.text)+'</label>';}).join('')+'</div><div class="f"><b>'+esc(Q.age.title)+'</b><input type="number" id="age" min="18" max="99"></div></div>'+
      '<div class="card"><label class="opt" style="margin-top:0"><input type="checkbox" id="ok"> '+esc(Q.consent.title)+'</label><div class="row"><button class="btn" id="go">Start</button></div><div class="err"></div></div>';
    document.getElementById('go').onclick=function(){
      if(!document.getElementById('ok').checked)return err('Consent is needed to continue.');
      var av=document.getElementById('age').value, g=app.querySelector('input[name=gender]:checked');
      if(av&&!(Number(av)>=18&&Number(av)<=99))return err('Age must be between 18 and 99, or leave it empty.');
      ac();var b=this;b.disabled=true;var calls=[SPSite.answer('consent',true)];if(g)calls.push(SPSite.answer('gender',g.value));if(av)calls.push(SPSite.answer('age',Number(av)));
      Promise.all(calls).then(function(rs){var bad=rs.filter(function(r){return !ok(r);})[0];if(bad){b.disabled=false;return err(bad.error);}st.step='sound';save();route();});
    };
  }
  function soundCheck(){
    app.innerHTML='<h1>1 · Sound check</h1><div class="card"><p>Press play. You should hear a short tune.</p><div class="row"><button class="btn sec" id="pl">▶ Play the tune</button></div><div class="row"><button class="btn" id="yes" disabled>I heard it</button><button class="btn sec" id="no" disabled>I did not hear anything</button></div><div class="err"></div></div>';
    document.getElementById('pl').onclick=function(){playBuffer(tune(),function(){document.getElementById('yes').disabled=false;document.getElementById('no').disabled=false;});};
    document.getElementById('yes').onclick=function(){st.step='volume';save();route();};
    document.getElementById('no').onclick=function(){err('Please check that your browser is allowed to play sound, that the volume is up and your headphones are connected, then play it again.');};
  }
  function volume(){
    var src=null;
    app.innerHTML='<h1>2 · Set the volume</h1><div class="card"><p>Turn your volume down, press play, then turn it up while the noise plays until it is as loud as is still comfortable. This noise is as loud as the loudest recordings.</p><div class="row"><button class="btn sec" id="loud">▶ Play loud noise (10 s)</button></div>'+
      '<p style="margin-top:16px">Now listen to this quiet noise, as quiet as the quietest recordings. You should still hear it clearly.</p><div class="row"><button class="btn sec" id="quiet">▶ Play quiet noise (5 s)</button></div>'+
      '<p style="margin-top:16px"><b>From now on, please do not change the volume.</b></p><div class="row"><button class="btn" id="nx" disabled>I can hear the quiet noise clearly</button></div><div class="err"></div></div>';
    var heard={loud:0,quiet:0};
    function chk(){document.getElementById('nx').disabled=!(heard.loud&&heard.quiet);}
    document.getElementById('loud').onclick=function(){if(src)try{src.stop();}catch(e){}src=playBuffer(noiseBuffer(10,-11.06),function(){heard.loud=1;chk();});};
    document.getElementById('quiet').onclick=function(){if(src)try{src.stop();}catch(e){}src=playBuffer(noiseBuffer(5,-28.8),function(){heard.quiet=1;chk();});};
    document.getElementById('nx').onclick=function(){if(src)try{src.stop();}catch(e){}st.step='hp';st.hp={trial:0,correct:0};save();route();};
  }
  function hp(){
    var h=st.hp;
    if(h.trial>=6){
      return SPSite.answer('headphone_score',h.correct).then(function(){
        if(h.correct>=5){st.step='prac';st.pi=0;save();route();}
        else{app.innerHTML='<h1>Headphone test not passed</h1><div class="card"><p>You heard the hidden tone in '+h.correct+' of 6 trials. This test only works with headphones (not speakers). Please put on headphones and try again.</p><div class="row"><button class="btn" id="again">Try the headphone test again</button></div></div>';document.getElementById('again').onclick=function(){st.hp={trial:0,correct:0};save();route();};}
      });
    }
    var target=Math.floor(Math.random()*3);
    app.innerHTML='<h1>3 · Headphone test</h1><p>Trial '+(h.trial+1)+' of 6. You will hear three bursts of noise. One of them has a faint tone hidden inside it. Which one?</p><div class="card"><div class="row"><button class="btn sec" id="pl">▶ Play the three sounds</button></div><div class="iv"><button data-i="0" disabled>1</button><button data-i="1" disabled>2</button><button data-i="2" disabled>3</button></div><div class="err"></div></div>';
    var bufs=[0,1,2].map(function(i){return hpInterval(i===target);}), btns=app.querySelectorAll('.iv button');
    document.getElementById('pl').onclick=function(){
      var a=ac(),t0=a.currentTime+0.1;this.disabled=true;
      bufs.forEach(function(b,i){var s=a.createBufferSource();s.buffer=b;s.connect(a.destination);s.start(t0+i*1.5);setTimeout(function(){btns.forEach(function(x){x.classList.toggle('now',x.getAttribute('data-i')==i);});},(0.1+i*1.5)*1000);});
      setTimeout(function(){btns.forEach(function(x){x.classList.remove('now');x.disabled=false;});},(0.1+3*1.5)*1000);
    };
    btns.forEach(function(x){x.onclick=function(){h.trial++;if(Number(x.getAttribute('data-i'))===target)h.correct++;save();hp();};});
  }
  function player(f,label,done){
    var au=new Audio();au.src=f.url;au.preload='auto';
    app.querySelector('#stage').innerHTML='<div class="play"><button class="btn" id="pb">▶ '+esc(label)+'</button><div class="bar"><i id="pbar"></i></div></div>';
    var pb=document.getElementById('pb'),bar=document.getElementById('pbar'),tm=null;
    pb.onclick=function(){pb.disabled=true;au.currentTime=0;au.play().catch(function(){pb.disabled=false;err('The recording could not play. Press play again.');});
      tm=setInterval(function(){var d=Math.min(PLAY_S,au.duration||PLAY_S);bar.style.width=Math.min(100,100*au.currentTime/d)+'%';},200);};
    au.onended=function(){clearInterval(tm);bar.style.width='100%';done();};
  }
  function trial(f,head,isPractice,onDone){
    var labels=st.layout.map(function(v){for(var i=0;i<Q.sources.choices.length;i++)if(Q.sources.choices[i].value===v)return Q.sources.choices[i];}).filter(Boolean), sel={}, rating=null;
    app.innerHTML=head+'<div class="card"><p style="color:var(--ink)"><b>Step 1.</b> Listen to the recording (15 s). Then choose the sounds you heard.</p><div id="stage"></div><div id="q"></div><div class="err"></div></div>';
    player(f,'Play recording',function(){
      document.getElementById('q').innerHTML='<p style="color:var(--ink);margin-top:14px"><b>'+esc(Q.sources.title)+'</b></p><div class="labels">'+labels.map(function(c){return '<button data-v="'+esc(c.value)+'">'+esc(c.text)+'</button>';}).join('')+'</div><div class="row"><button class="btn" id="nx">Next</button></div>';
      app.querySelectorAll('.labels button').forEach(function(x){x.onclick=function(){var v=x.getAttribute('data-v');sel[v]=!sel[v];x.classList.toggle('on',!!sel[v]);err('');};});
      document.getElementById('nx').onclick=function(){
        var vals=Object.keys(sel).filter(function(k){return sel[k];});if(!vals.length)return err('Please choose at least one sound (or “Non-identifiable” / “Other”).');
        var go=function(){step2(vals);};
        if(isPractice)go();else{this.disabled=true;SPSite.answer('sources',vals,{key:f.name,shown:[f.name]}).then(function(r){if(!ok(r))return err(r.error);go();});}
      };
    });
    function step2(){
      app.querySelector('.card').innerHTML='<p style="color:var(--ink)"><b>Step 2.</b> Listen to the same recording again. Then rate it.</p><div id="stage"></div><div id="q"></div><div class="err"></div>';
      player(f,'Play recording again',function(){
        var b='';for(var v=1;v<=10;v++)b+='<button data-v="'+v+'">'+v+'</button>';
        document.getElementById('q').innerHTML='<p style="color:var(--ink);margin-top:14px"><b>'+esc(Q.annoyance.title)+'</b></p><div class="scale">'+b+'</div><div class="ends"><span>1 · Not at all</span><span>10 · Extremely</span></div>';
        app.querySelectorAll('.scale button').forEach(function(x){x.onclick=function(){
          var v=Number(x.getAttribute('data-v'));app.querySelectorAll('.scale button').forEach(function(y){y.disabled=true;});
          if(isPractice)return onDone();
          SPSite.answer('annoyance',v,{key:f.name,shown:[f.name]}).then(function(r){if(!ok(r)){app.querySelectorAll('.scale button').forEach(function(y){y.disabled=false;});return err(r.error);}onDone();});
        };});
      });
    }
  }
  function practice(){
    if(st.pi>=Math.min(PRACTICE,prac.length)){app.innerHTML='<h1>Practice done</h1><div class="card"><p>Now the real recordings begin: '+N+' recordings, each played twice.</p><button class="btn" id="go">Start</button></div>';document.getElementById('go').onclick=function(){st.step='main';save();route();};return;}
    trial(prac[st.pi],'<h1>Practice '+(st.pi+1)+' of '+Math.min(PRACTICE,prac.length)+'</h1><p>Practice answers are not recorded.</p>',true,function(){st.pi++;save();practice();});
  }
  function main(){
    var i=0;while(i<st.list.length&&st.done[st.list[i]])i++;
    if(i>=st.list.length)return finish();
    var f=byName(clips,st.list[i]);
    trial(f,'<p>Recording '+(i+1)+' of '+st.list.length+'</p><div class="progress"><i style="width:'+(100*i/st.list.length)+'%"></i></div>',false,function(){st.done[f.name]=true;save();window.scrollTo(0,0);main();});
  }
  function finish(){
    app.innerHTML='<h1>Thank you!</h1><div class="card"><p id="fin">Submitting…</p><div class="err"></div></div>';
    SPSite.complete().then(function(r){if(!ok(r)){err(r.error||'Some answers are missing.');setTimeout(function(){var m=r.missing||[];if(m.indexOf('consent')>=0)st.step='intro';else if(m.indexOf('headphone_score')>=0)st.step='hp';else{st.done={};st.step='main';}save();route();},1800);}else{try{localStorage.removeItem('delta2022:state');}catch(e){}var s=document.getElementById('fin');if(s)s.textContent='Your answers are saved.';}});
  }
  function route(){
    var s=st.step;
    if(s==='sound')return soundCheck();
    if(s==='volume')return volume();
    if(s==='hp')return hp();
    if(s==='prac')return practice();
    if(s==='main')return main();
    intro();
  }
  SPSite.onReady(function(ctx){
    ['consent','gender','age','headphone_score','sources','annoyance'].forEach(function(n){Q[n]=SPSite.getQuestion(n)||{};});
    clips=(SPSite.getMedia('clips')||[]).filter(function(f){return /\.(mp3|wav|ogg|m4a)$/i.test(f.name);});
    prac=(SPSite.getMedia('practice')||[]).filter(function(f){return /\.(mp3|wav|ogg|m4a)$/i.test(f.name);});
    try{st=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('delta2022:state'));}catch(e){st=null;}
    if(!st||!Array.isArray(st.list)||st.list.some(function(n){return !byName(clips,n);}))st={step:'intro',list:shuffle(clips).slice(0,N).map(function(f){return f.name;}),done:{},layout:shuffle((Q.sources.choices||[]).map(function(c){return c.value;}))}; // 10 random recordings; label layout random per participant, as in the paper
    prac=shuffle(prac);
    var a=(ctx&&ctx.answers)||{};
    if(a.consent!==true)st.step='intro';
    save();route();
  });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

config.description: Online listening test with headphones. After a sound check, volume setting and a Huggins-pitch headphone test, participants hear 10 binaural 15-second recordings of urban places in London and Venice (drawn at random from 120). For each recording they first tick every sound source they can hear (24 labels: traffic, birds, speech, construction, water…), then hear it again and rate “How annoying is this sound?” from 1 (not at all) to 10 (extremely). Rebuilt from Mitchell, Erfanian, Soelistyo, Oberman, Kang, Aldridge, Xue & Aletta (2022), Int. J. Environ. Res. Public Health 19(22): 14872, with the authors' open DeLTA recordings (Zenodo 7158057, CC BY 4.0). The page source holds, for each recording, the majority source labels and mean annoyance from the original study (script id delta-original).

paper.title: Effects of Soundscape Complexity on Urban Noise Annoyance Ratings: A Large-Scale Online Listening Experiment
paper.venue: International Journal of Environmental Research and Public Health
